Probabilistic structures, asymptotic behavior, and mathematical methods for random systems.

Metastability

title: Research
text:
My current interests are centered on probability theory and stochastic processes, with particular attention to interacting particle systems and metastability.


I am currently at an early stage of graduate study. This page records my main research directions rather than presenting a formal list of projects. Research projects, preprints, collaborations, and talks will be added as they develop.

title: Research
text:
Areas of interest


Probability Theory
Probabilistic structures, asymptotic methods, and the behavior of random systems.


Stochastic Processes
Continuous-time stochastic dynamics and long-time behavior.


Interacting Particle Systems
Collective behavior arising from local interactions among random particles.


Metastability
Rare transitions, effective dynamics, and hierarchical time scales.
